title: She learned to swim at 59. At 80 she became the oldest woman to finish the Ironman World Championship.

posts.facebook:
Natalie Grabow couldn't swim at 59. At 80 she finished the Ironman World Championship in Kona — the oldest woman ever to do it.

Natalie Grabow learned to swim at 59 so she could try triathlon. On 11 October 2025, aged 80, she became the oldest woman to finish the Ironman World Championship in Kailua-Kona, in 16:45:26.

Learning a 'basic' skill like swimming in your late fifties can open a 20-year athletic career.
